statement: ∀ (A B D E : Finset ℕ) (t : ℕ), let r := fun (B' : Finset ℕ) (n : ℕ) => (A.filter (fun p => p≤n ∧ n-p ∈ B')).card; t * (E.filter (fun n => t ≤ r B n ∧ r (B \ D) n = 0)).card ≤ A.card * (B ∩ D).card

plain_statement.zh: 删除大步长后有多少富终点会完全失去路径
plain_statement.en: Bound rich endpoints destroyed by deleting long steps

brief.zh: 每个失去全部路径的富终点消耗至少 t 个被删有序对，而每个小步长和被删大步长只能配成一对。
brief.en: Charge each destroyed rich target at least t distinct removed pairs; bound total pairs by the product of the two step counts.
